stem.text: The diagrams show four fatty acids, each with a chain of 18 carbon atoms.
Which fatty acid, as part of a phospholipid molecule, would contribute most to the fluidity of a cell surface membrane?

A.alt: Skeletal formula of a fatty acid chain ending in COOH.

B.alt: Skeletal formula of a fatty acid chain ending in COOH, with one C=C double bond.

C.alt: Skeletal formula of a fatty acid chain ending in COOH, with two C=C double bonds.

D.alt: Skeletal formula of a fatty acid chain ending in COOH, with three C=C double bonds.
